checks: Real Firebase SDK signs in anonymously and writes the authenticated UID to Firestore emulator
Anonymous interest settings are saved to users/{uid}
Anonymous clicks, reader dwell, mixer settings, bookmarks, visits and device information reach Firestore
Anonymous UID persists after reload and cloud preferences/bookmarks restore when local copies are absent
Removing an anonymous bookmark persists its deletion in Firestore
Emulator test rules allow the owner and reject a different anonymous UID
Offline interest changes remain on the device and synchronize on reconnection
